success_failure_thresholds.inherited: Exactly as archived component protocols and the inherited claim-freeze. Inconsistent or stricter inherited gates remain visible; they cannot be waived after results.
success_failure_thresholds.high_na_support: All original support-script acceptance criteria; geometric-only and raw-Jones controls retain their prespecified failures.
success_failure_thresholds.radial: All 45 common radial cases must pass their individual epsilon, weighted spectral and padding criteria; rank gap is an outcome, not a pass criterion.
success_failure_thresholds.negative_controls: Under-resolution, stale/corrupt cache, budget rejection, nonnegative weights, create-only cache and standalone normal ownership tests must pass.
success_failure_thresholds.full_support: Accounting completion only. Exceeding the prespecified dense-normal budget is a reported representation limit, never numerical validation or an observed OOM.

main_text_eligibility.high_na: Known-case correspondence and accuracy illustration with prior-art attribution. Timing fields are diagnostic only.
main_text_eligibility.waxs: Inherited identical curved-target, candidate and strongest-eligible-comparator rules. Physical planar detector coordinates do not by themselves make exact Ewald targets a Cartesian reciprocal grid.
main_text_eligibility.odt: Report native Cartesian Toeplitz separately from the selected-mode physical modal normal. Every compiled normal comparison includes an equivalent dense-radial compiled normal and shared-SVD arm; its within-arm composition ratio is not a CPSWF-specific or end-to-end reconstruction speedup.
main_text_eligibility.cpswf: Selected-mode representation preparation, accuracy, observed ranks and checked reuse, if both returns pass. No near-optimality claim outside tested metrics. Default density rank selection is conservative, not minimal. Timings from five/seven-trial CPU pilot designs remain descriptive; no stable CPSWF headline speed ratio is preauthorized.
main_text_eligibility.composite: Inherited same-chain materialization and CPU-only timing conditions, with direct numerical reference, preparation and break-even.
forbidden: full original-grid active-support validation from selected modes or byte estimates
